cases.title: First lesson on Mentor Practice: Title, its pairs, leave-outs, a frame, then the read-the-graph step

rubric.reason: Turn 1 proposes only Title, notes 'the layer you eased last time', and names its pairs from the snapshot: 'its Position from 0.5 to 1.5 s, 1.5 to 3 s and 3 to 4.37 s, and its Scale from 0.5 to 1.5 s'.

Turn 1 gives one short line per listed kind (hidden Old Take, null CTRL, 'I can't see inside Icon yet', 'An expression drives Logo's Rotation', and the three ease-first pairs), never calls anything fine, and asks once whether any of Title's moves should land hard.

Turns 1–2 ask the learner to open the Graph Editor, choose Edit Speed Graph, and say where Title's 0.5–1.5 s Position move is fastest; Turn 3 previews a frame at 1 s inside that pair and explains influence in plain words ('Short reach out of the key at 0.5 s… Long reach into the key at 1.5 s') with no influence or speed numbers.
Turn 1 refers to the record in plain words, 'Title, the layer you eased last time', which matches the recorded easing lesson on Title, and reads out no fields.

Every name and time the mentor uses (Title Position/Scale at 0.5, 1.5, 3, 4.37 s; Old Take, CTRL, Icon, Logo's Rotation, Subtitle's Opacity, Bar's X Position, Glow's Blurriness; the frame at 1 s) appears in the snapshot or preview tool results.
